name: tracker-flag-finished-item
goal: A structured flag on a finished (done) tracker item is shown, not dropped: it stays in list --flagged, the digest, the Chief of Staff push and every needs-you view until answered, proven with the real CLI and service

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Report (99szpz on 7b36a973a2): flag on a done item exits 0, sets needs_daniel, no needs-you view lists it. Real isolated service + CLI on origin/main a3459b6874: 'tracker list' (hides done by design) omits it and 'needs-attention' returned [] (watchdog alert channel); 'list --flagged' and digest 'To unblock (Daniel)' list it as ITEM DONE, FLAG STILL OPEN. 7b36a973a2 already has that digest tag (e90da92a37). Notification fixture: Chief of Staff gets the ask for a done item at +1m by the direct-reminder path. No product regression reproduced.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: No test raised a flag on an already done item through the real CLI, so nothing fixed or protected the behaviour. Added test/commands/projects-sessions/tracker-flag-finished-item.test.ts (in test:unit).

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.

closed.reason: No red is possible: current main already SHOWS a flag on a done item in every ask view and pushes it to Chief of Staff, so there is no repair. Kept as a guard-only change (j779tm): test/commands/projects-sessions/tracker-flag-finished-item.test.ts; it failed on all 5 single-point mutations in a scratch worktree (digest SQL, list --flagged, trackerStructuredAsk, notification flagged(), flag refused on done) and passed once restored. propose/implement/guard are gated on red and stay pending.
